title: Price Lock and Notice of Price Changes — FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions
content:
**Price lock.** The price of a subscription to FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions is held for 12 months after sign-up.

**Price changes.** A later price change applies only to shipments that leave at least 30 calendar days after notice of the change.

| Grade | Months the price is held after sign-up | Calendar days of notice before a price change applies |
|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 12 | 30 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 12 | 30 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 12 | 30 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 12 | 30 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 12 | 30 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 12 | 30 |

### Reading the two sections together

| Shipment leaves within 12 months after sign-up? | Shipment leaves at least 30 days after notice of a change? | Price for that shipment |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | The held price |
| No | Yes | The changed price |
| No | No | Not the changed price; the change does not yet apply to this shipment |

### Notice boundary (hypothetical dates)

Notice of a price change is given on a hypothetical 1 March, after the 12-month hold has ended.

- A shipment leaving on 31 March leaves 30 calendar days after notice; the change applies to it.
- A shipment leaving on 30 March leaves 29 calendar days after notice; the change does not apply to it.

### Basis questions

**The subscription was signed up six months ago and a price change has been announced. Does the change reach the next shipment?** No. The price is held for 12 months after sign-up.

**Does notice of a change reach a shipment that leaves the day after notice?** No. A change reaches only shipments leaving at least 30 calendar days after notice.
